description.value: Easy Click Wholesaler is a Nanaimo-based B2B supplier of sustainable food service packaging, offering takeout containers, bags, foil trays, cutlery, and cups in bulk to restaurants, caterers, and food trucks across Canada. The business focuses on eco-conscious materials such as bagasse, recyclable aluminum, and kraft paper. A touring cyclist arriving here would find a packaging warehouse oriented entirely toward trade customers, with no food, groceries, or public-facing retail services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website clearly identifies Easy Click Wholesaler as a B2B wholesale supplier of food service packaging (takeout containers, bags, cutlery, cups, foil trays) — not a grocery retailer. The OSM tags (shop=wholesale, wholesale=meal_packaging) are accurate but the Groceries category assignment from the matching system is a mismatch. The website address '3024 Unit A Barons Rd aa Nanaimo, BC V9T 4B5' matches the OSM address (the 'aa' in the website appears to be a data-entry artifact); no phone number is visible in the fetched website content, so the OSM phone cannot be confirmed via website. No cyclist-relevant amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, food) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Category mismatch: OSM shop=wholesale/wholesale=meal_packaging was matched to Groceries, but this is a trade-only food service packaging supplier with no food, drink, or consumer goods for sale.
Website address contains 'aa' as a placeholder city-field artefact ('3024 Unit A Barons Rd aa Nanaimo') — not a substantive discrepancy.
Phone number from OSM (+1 250 585-0525) could not be confirmed via website content; only an email address (EASYCLICKWHOLESALER@GMAIL.COM) is displayed on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business with a live website and confirmed address. Despite the category mismatch, the place physically exists and is publicly accessible; curation of utility to cyclists is out of scope.
